scoring_justification: MO compositions and energies are compared to reported paper values; geometry bond lengths recomputed from XYZ coordinates.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference bond lengths and MO composition gold values
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 for MO compositions; experimental Mn–Cl and average Mn–N distances from crystal structure reported in the paper
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper text and Table 1 (alpha-174,173,172,171,170,169); bond lengths from the crystal structure values stated in the paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All values are the paper's own reported results; the reference oracle writes them exactly, so the checker verifies correctness against the paper's own data.

schema.description: XYZ format: first line integer N atoms, second line comment, then N lines element symbol and x y z coordinates in Angstrom.

outputs.description: Optimized geometry of [MnIII(TPP)Cl], used to check Mn-Cl and average Mn-N bond lengths against known reference values with tolerance.
MO compositions and energies for six alpha-spin orbitals, checked against reference values with tolerances appropriate for DFT method.

output_contract.notes: Geometry and MO results are compared to known reference data with appropriate tolerances that account for method dependence of DFT calculations.
